# Rishabh Karmakar

> Software engineer and machine learning researcher. MS Computer Science (Machine Learning) at Columbia University; previously four years at Wells Fargo, most recently as Senior Software Engineer, building agentic AI, semantic search and banking platforms. Author of four peer-reviewed papers.

This is a single-page portfolio. All content is in the HTML of the home page.

- [Experience and education](https://rishabh-karmakar.github.io/#record): Roles at Wells Fargo, internships, Columbia University
- [Skills](https://rishabh-karmakar.github.io/#toolkit): Tools, frameworks and certifications
